    The coefficient ring 𝒪 = ℤ/4 (Section 10) #

    "Let 𝒪 = ℤ/4. […] the coefficient sequence 0 → 𝔽₂ → 𝒪 → 𝔽₂ → 0."

    The reduction red : ℤ/4 → 𝔽₂, the set-theoretic section lift, and the additive embedding tw : 𝔽₂ → 2𝒪, a ↦ 2ã. Every statement is a finite check.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
